sv4pt5-1.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

attacks.name: Guard Press

abilities.name: Exploding Energy
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Pin Missile

sv4pt5-3.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

attacks.name: Furious Kicks
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-4.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

attacks.name: Colony Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached.

attacks.name: Psy Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Dazzling Gaze
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost Colorless more.

Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

sv4pt5-7.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

abilities.name: Flare Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

sv4pt5-8.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

sv4pt5-9.flavorText: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

attacks.name: Volcanic Heat
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

sv4pt5-10.flavorText: Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this Pokémon's body to resemble its environment— it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

sv4pt5-11.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Cinder Cannon
attacks.text: You may discard a Fighting Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 120 more damage.

sv4pt5-12.flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-13.flavorText: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

sv4pt5-14.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

attacks.name: Flame Cannon
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

abilities.name: Fire Off
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Fire Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

sv4pt5-15.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

attacks.name: Into the Deep
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Freeze-Dry
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv4pt5-16.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

sv4pt5-17.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv4pt5-18.flavorText: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Electrical Grounding
abilities.text: When 1 of your Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a Lightning Energy from that Pokémon to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-19.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

attacks.name: Shine On
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put that card on the bottom of your deck.

sv4pt5-20.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

attacks.name: Aqua Spark
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached, this attack does 120 more damage.

sv4pt5-21.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

attacks.name: United Thunder
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv4pt5-22.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

sv4pt5-23.flavorText: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psychic Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

sv4pt5-24.flavorText: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

attacks.name: Triple Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-25.flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

abilities.name: Clairvoyant Sense
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

sv4pt5-26.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

sv4pt5-27.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv4pt5-28.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

attacks.name: Miracle Force
attacks.text: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

abilities.name: Psychic Embrace
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sleep Inducer
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. The new Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

sv4pt5-30.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

attacks.name: Mimed Games
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses an attack from 1 of their Pokémon in play. Use the chosen attack as this attack.

sv4pt5-31.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-32.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

attacks.name: Attraction Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. Put 6 damage counters instead of 3 on that Pokémon for this Special Condition.

sv4pt5-33.flavorText: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

attacks.name: Fickle Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv4pt5-34.flavorText: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

sv4pt5-35.flavorText: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv4pt5-36.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

attacks.name: Ghost Eye
attacks.text: Put 7 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

sv4pt5-37.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

sv4pt5-38.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Burned. Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

sv4pt5-39.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

attacks.name: Life Sucker
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fighting Sword
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 100 more damage.

sv4pt5-40.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv4pt5-41.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

attacks.name: Graveyard Gamboling
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Psychic Pokémon in your discard pile.

sv4pt5-42.flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

attacks.name: Last Respects
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Psychic Pokémon in your discard pile.

sv4pt5-43.flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

attacks.name: Chest-ouflage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-44.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

attacks.name: Monkey Beatdown
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-45.flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

attacks.name: Raging Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-46.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

attacks.name: Rage Fist
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

attacks.name: Dynamite Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-47.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

sv4pt5-48.flavorText: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

attacks.name: Cragalanche
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Powerful Spin
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

sv4pt5-49.flavorText: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-50.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

sv4pt5-51.flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

attacks.name: Slow-Acting Syncope
attacks.text: At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.

sv4pt5-52.flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

attacks.name: Great Bash
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Quaking Demolition
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you must discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Burning Darkness
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

abilities.name: Infernal Reign
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw a card.

sv4pt5-55.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

attacks.name: Dark Slumber
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

sv4pt5-56.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Night Gate
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv4pt5-57.flavorText: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

attacks.name: Find a Home
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-58.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

attacks.name: Needle Bone
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

abilities.name: Toxic Wetland
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if a Stadium is in play, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5-60.flavorText: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

attacks.name: Lambaste
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

sv4pt5-61.flavorText: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

sv4pt5-62.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Intimidating Howl
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

sv4pt5-63.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

attacks.name: Rev
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

sv4pt5-64.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 90 more damage.

abilities.name: Rumbling Engine
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

sv4pt5-65.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

attacks.name: Iron-Clad Roll
attacks.text: After doing damage, you may discard all Future Booster Energy Capsules from this Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 150 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Lavish Hospitality
attacks.text: You may attach any number of Basic Metal Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Scintillating Surfing
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-67.flavorText: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

sv4pt5-68.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

attacks.name: Covert Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dominating Echo
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Acceleration Drive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-70.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv4pt5-71.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

attacks.name: Finest Selection
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Perfume Press
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv4pt5-72.flavorText: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

sv4pt5-73.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

attacks.name: Family Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Maushold in play.

sv4pt5-74.flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

attacks.name: Motivate
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Squawk and Seize
abilities.text: Once during your first turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Squawk and Seize Ability during your turn.

sv4pt5-92.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

abilities.name: Semi-Blooming Energy
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

sv4pt5-93.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

abilities.name: Fully Blooming Energy
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

sv4pt5-94.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-95.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-96.flavorText: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

attacks.name: Flowery Zephyr
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Drifting Dodge
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

sv4pt5-97.flavorText: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

attacks.name: Fluffy Breeze
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Drifting Dodge
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

sv4pt5-98.flavorText: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

sv4pt5-99.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

sv4pt5-100.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

abilities.name: Freezing Disaster
abilities.text: Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed.

sv4pt5-101.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

attacks.name: Nutrients
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

sv4pt5-102.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

attacks.name: Apply Oil
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

sv4pt5-103.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

abilities.name: Enriching Oil
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

sv4pt5-104.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

attacks.name: Furious Kicks
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-105.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

attacks.name: Increasing Spice
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-106.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

attacks.name: Spicy Headbutt
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Grass and Fire type.

sv4pt5-107.flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-108.flavorText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

attacks.name: Blazing Destruction
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

sv4pt5-109.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

abilities.name: Flare Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

sv4pt5-110.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blaze Dash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-111.flavorText: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv4pt5-112.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

abilities.name: Ardent Dancing
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Evolution Pokémon.

sv4pt5-113.flavorText: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

sv4pt5-114.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

attacks.name: Flame Cannon
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

abilities.name: Fire Off
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Fire Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

sv4pt5-115.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

sv4pt5-116.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Strange Behavior
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-117.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv4pt5-118.flavorText: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

abilities.name: Mysterious Comet
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this Pokémon and all attached cards.

sv4pt5-119.flavorText: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv4pt5-120.flavorText: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

attacks.name: Twisting Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-121.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

attacks.name: Undersea Tunnel
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

sv4pt5-122.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

attacks.name: Valiant Evolution
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-123.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

sv4pt5-124.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

attacks.name: Slim Screw
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack can be used for Water.

sv4pt5-125.flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

attacks.name: Release Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Tatsugiri in your discard pile.

sv4pt5-126.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

attacks.name: Mise en Place
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Basic Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Curl Up
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

sv4pt5-127.flavorText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

sv4pt5-128.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

sv4pt5-129.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

abilities.name: Super Cold
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

sv4pt5-130.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv4pt5-131.flavorText: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Electrical Grounding
abilities.text: When 1 of your Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a Lightning Energy from that Pokémon to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-132.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

sv4pt5-133.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

attacks.name: Bang Boom Chain
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tools from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

sv4pt5-134.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv4pt5-135.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

sv4pt5-136.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Swelling Flash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your hand and you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, you may put this Pokémon onto your Bench.

sv4pt5-137.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

attacks.name: Everyone Discharge
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Lightning Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

abilities.name: Electricity Pouches
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed.

sv4pt5-138.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

attacks.name: Gigantic Bolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Adverse Weather
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

sv4pt5-139.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-140.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Loud Mix
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

sv4pt5-141.flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

sv4pt5-142.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv4pt5-143.flavorText: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

attacks.name: Electro Paws
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Electrogenesis
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-144.flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

sv4pt5-145.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

attacks.name: United Thunder
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv4pt5-146.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

abilities.name: Balloon Therapy
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Therapeutic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

sv4pt5-147.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

sv4pt5-148.flavorText: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

attacks.name: Teleportation Attack
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv4pt5-149.flavorText: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

attacks.name: Grasping Draw
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

sv4pt5-150.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

attacks.name: Triple Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-151.flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

abilities.name: Clairvoyant Sense
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

sv4pt5-152.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

sv4pt5-153.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv4pt5-154.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

attacks.name: Balloon Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-155.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

attacks.name: Curse Spreading
attacks.text: Put 8 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

sv4pt5-156.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

attacks.name: Mimed Games
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses an attack from 1 of their Pokémon in play. Use the chosen attack as this attack.

sv4pt5-157.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

abilities.name: Fettered in Misfortune
abilities.text: Basic Pokémon V in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

sv4pt5-158.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

attacks.name: Joust
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Mischievous Lock
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities, except for Mischievous Lock.

sv4pt5-159.flavorText: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

attacks.name: Ghost Eye
attacks.text: Put 7 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

sv4pt5-160.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Burned. Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

sv4pt5-161.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

attacks.name: Life Sucker
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fighting Sword
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 100 more damage.

sv4pt5-162.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

attacks.name: Revival Blessing
attacks.text: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv4pt5-163.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv4pt5-164.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

attacks.name: Scrap Pickup
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

sv4pt5-165.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Pulverizing Press
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv4pt5-166.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

attacks.name: Special Hammer
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.

abilities.name: Gather Materials
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

sv4pt5-167.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

attacks.name: Last Respects
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Psychic Pokémon in your discard pile.

sv4pt5-168.flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

attacks.name: Monkey Beatdown
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-169.flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

attacks.name: Raging Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-170.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

attacks.name: Rage Fist
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

attacks.name: Dynamite Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-171.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Combat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-172.flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-173.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

attacks.name: Avenging Knuckle
attacks.text: If any of your Fighting Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Accelerating Stab
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.

sv4pt5-174.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

abilities.name: Flying Entry
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

sv4pt5-175.flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

attacks.name: Salt Coating
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

sv4pt5-176.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

attacks.name: Salt Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-177.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

abilities.name: Blessed Salt
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

sv4pt5-178.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-179.flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

attacks.name: Find a Home
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-180.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

sv4pt5-181.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

sv4pt5-182.flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

abilities.name: Assaulting Hunt
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot.

sv4pt5-183.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

attacks.name: Night Eyes
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Unseen Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 70 more damage.

sv4pt5-184.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

sv4pt5-185.flavorText: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

attacks.name: Double-Edged Slash
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-186.flavorText: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

abilities.name: Leadership
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv4pt5-187.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Intimidating Howl
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

sv4pt5-188.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

attacks.name: Berry Search
attacks.text: Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

sv4pt5-189.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Colorful Graffiti
attacks.text: You may discard as many Basic Energy cards as you like from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each type of Basic Energy you discarded in this way.

sv4pt5-190.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

attacks.name: Punishing Scissors
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has an Ability.

sv4pt5-191.flavorText: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

attacks.name: Rev
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

sv4pt5-192.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 90 more damage.

abilities.name: Rumbling Engine
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

sv4pt5-193.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

sv4pt5-194.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

attacks.name: Acceleration Drive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv4pt5-195.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-196.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

sv4pt5-197.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Stompy Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

sv4pt5-198.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv4pt5-199.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

attacks.name: Ballistic Beak
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Zooming Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 1 damage counter on this Pokémon. If you do, draw a card.

sv4pt5-200.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

abilities.name: Transformative Start
abilities.text: Once during your first turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck and choose a Basic Pokémon you find there, except any Ditto. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all attached cards, and put the chosen Pokémon in its place. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-201.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

attacks.name: Thudding Press
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Voraciousness
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put up to 2 Leftovers cards from your discard pile into your hand.

sv4pt5-202.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

sv4pt5-203.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

abilities.name: Hearsay
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 1: put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand; or search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and then shuffle your deck.

sv4pt5-204.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

abilities.name: Nest Stash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may shuffle your hand and put it on the bottom of your deck. If you put any cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw a card.

sv4pt5-205.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

attacks.name: Enhanced Fang
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

sv4pt5-206.flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv4pt5-207.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

attacks.name: Finest Selection
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Perfume Press
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv4pt5-208.flavorText: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

sv4pt5-209.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

attacks.name: Family Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Maushold in play.

sv4pt5-210.flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

attacks.name: United Wings

abilities.name: Insta-Flock

sv4pt5-211.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

sv4pt5-226.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
